reuse.why: Extends the two existing holiday interpretation points (recurConfigToExdates and getDateWithSkippedWeekend's isOffDay) and reuses monthUtils parse/format helpers instead of adding new paths.

duplication.why: Little duplication, though the MM-DD format is recognised in two different ways (a regex in isYearlyHoliday for exdates, a slice(5) match in isHoliday).

placement.why: All logic stays in shared/schedules.ts beside the existing holiday handling; no server call site had to change.

scope.why: Only the holiday interpretation, a test and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Expanding yearly holidays into ~200 years of exdates from the start year is a brittle, heavy approach, and the two separate encodings of the MM-DD rule could diverge.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; both existing holiday consumers in shared/schedules.ts are updated in place

disguised_duplication.where: the 'MM-DD means every year' rule is encoded twice in shared/schedules.ts: isYearlyHoliday + year expansion in recurConfigToExdates, and date.slice(5) matching in isHoliday
